description: DING0 generates synthetic medium- and low-voltage electricity-distribution networks from open or publicly accessible inputs. Jonathan Amme and Guido Pleßmann at the Reiner Lemoine Institut deposited version 0.1.9 in October 2018, while the openego repository supplies the Python package, documentation and links to generated datasets. The inspected README states AGPL version 3 or later, clarifying Zenodo's misspelled apgl-v3 licence identifier; access is free. Network geography and resolution depend on the input data and configuration. Generated grids can provide topology for distribution power-flow and expansion-planning simulations, but synthetic layouts should not be treated as observed utility networks. The current package was not installed and its outputs were not checked. The related eGon-data catalogue record describes an input pipeline whose outputs feed DING0; it does not explicitly package this generator.
